name: Dick Gould
profileSummary: Dick Gould is an American tennis coach. He was the Men's Tennis Coach at Stanford University for 38 years from 1966 to 2004. The Stanford men's tennis teams won 17 NCAA Men's Tennis Championships, and 50 of his players won All-American honors under Gould's tenure. He was named the ITA-Wilson "Coach of the Decade" both for the 1980s and the 1990s.
